items.title: Budget 2027: Permanent Appointments For Doctors In 2027 After Housemanship
items.summary: PM Anwar declares an end to the contract doctor system. Doctors will be offered permanent positions next year after completing housemanship. Budget 2027 increased FDS allowance from RM30-RM100, and post-basic incentive for paramedics/nurses to RM200/month. items.title: Budget 2027: Health Ministry Gets RM47.7b, Smallest Increase In Five Years
items.summary: Despite health worker shortages, the Health Ministry only received RM47.7 billion in Budget 2027, a minimal 2.5% increase (RM1.18 billion) from 2026, marking the smallest raise in 5 years since Budget 2022. Devex only rose RM5 million for 2027 from 2026. The post Budget 2027: Health Ministry Gets RM47.7b, Smallest Increase In Five Years appeared first on CodeBlue .
